description: The MAUPP and REACT projects publish a land-cover map of Dakar derived from Pléiades imagery at 0.5-metre spatial resolution. The repository describes four raster packages: direct random-forest classification, rule-based correction focused on built-up errors, a smoothed product and a version restoring shadow classes. A separate text legend maps pixel values to labels and suggested colours. Zenodo explicitly assigns the MIT licence, permitting free reuse, even though that licence is uncommon for geospatial datasets. The maps can support urban demand allocation, green-space representation and infrastructure-exposure modelling. Classification errors and differences between postprocessing variants constrain interpretation; acquisition dates and raster encoding were not independently checked. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Dakar Very-High Resolution Land Cover Map
notes: G4-0425; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
